items.title: Albert "June" Gardner Interview, 1996-04-17
items.q: Chief Fletcher, Bozo, Clarence Davis, all these, Big Bob.

ctx.x: Did you know the Indians? Oh yeah.

And all in the neighborhood. Different guys. Remember when you were? And they were Chilch and Wow Magnolia. Wow Magnolia. Yeah. Chief Fletcher, Bozo, Clarence Davis, all these, Big Bob. This was a big thing. I'm sorry I'm stuck for names. I know. All I'm like the guys would be making the uniforms and come by my mom and she would help. It was like everything happened. In the neighborhood. On Magnolia. Everything passed at one time. That was just another part of the city. But all you'd do was stand right there.…
I saw something where it said you were referred to as the Amazing June Gardner.
